mod.cannedmonster.name: CannedMonster
tooltip.cannedmonster.small: Can fuse; an empty can used or thrown at a fused mob peels one member at a time, but cannot store the whole fusion
tooltip.cannedmonster.large: Can capture and store fused mobs
tooltip.cannedmonster.hand: Use on a mob to capture/fuse; hold and release an empty can to extract a member; use on a block to release
tooltip.cannedmonster.eat: Hold use to finish eating a filled can; release early to cancel. Press and release again with an empty can to extract a member
tooltip.cannedmonster.throw: Hold use to charge, release to throw; captures or peels on hit, throw straight up to hit yourself
tooltip.cannedmonster.random: Spawns a random mob on block impact; consumed on success
tooltip.cannedmonster.spatial_pending: Spatial behavior is not implemented yet
